name: Floorwork
description:
You are subject to no combat penalties when prone: you do not automatically lose engagements, melee attacks against you are not favored and your attacks are not ill-favored.

Additionally, while prone, you may spend a half action and 1 MP to roll Strength vs Dexterity against an adjacent creature. On a win, the creature is knocked prone.

Describe how you attack from the ground.
